issues.title: Conflicting merchant specifications regarding USB-C cable inclusion
issues.explanation: Two merchant-confirmed specifications directly contradict each other regarding package contents. One specification states that the USB-C cable and power adapter are not included, while another confirms that the USB-C cable is included in every lamp package. Because these merchant sources contradict each other, this conflict cannot be patched on the product page until resolved by the merchant.
issues.question: Is the USB-C cable included in the lamp package or sold separately?
